allowPermissionsDesc: Tango efungolami, ba appels nionso ya outil MCP ekondimama automatiquement sans kolakisa ba dialogues ya ndingisa. Paramètre oyo etali mokili mobimba mpo na masolo nyonso, ata mpe masolo ya sika.

runtimeSettings.title: Paramètres ya tango ya kosala
runtimeSettings.description: Configurer ndenge nini Novera e gérer pe emekaka lisusu MCP ba serveurs.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Tango ya likolo ya kozela eyano ya esaleli ya MCP yambo ya kosilisa tango.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Longest outil résultat ebombami na lisolo. Eloko nyonso oyo eleki oyo ekatamaka mpe etyami elembo lokola ekatamaki, yango wana mbano moko ya monene ekoki te kosilisa contexte ya modèle. Set na 0 mpo na kobatela ba résultats mobimba.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRouting: Routage ya bisaleli ya mayele MCP
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: Tango efungolami, Novera eponaka ba serveurs MCP oyo etali yango liboso ya ko charger bisaleli. Désactiver mpo na ko charger toujours liste mobimba ya bisaleli MCP.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModel: Salelá modèle oyo epesameli mpo na kosala routage
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: Tango routage ya mayele ezali kosala, tambuisa étape ya routage na modèle ekeseni (mbala mingi ya moke) na esika ya modèle ya chat. Boma mpo na kosalela ntango nyonso modèle ya chat active mpo na routage.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Pona fournisseur na modèle na esika moko. Kaka ba modèles légers nde etangami donc routage etikalaka mbangu pe ya talo moke.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: Ba modèles ya poids légers ezali te. Bakisa modèle ya moke to configurer ba touches API na Modèles.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptySearch: Ezali na boyokani te mpo na “{{query}}”.
